events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, the music world lost a true icon. Elvis Presley's influence on rock and popular culture remains unmatched. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries several days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, we lost a voice that defined a generation. Tupac Shakur's lyrics and legacy still resonate deeply today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: It's 56 years since the world lost Jimi Hendrix, a musician who redefined the electric guitar. His innovative sound continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous in history, but what's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us countless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. Its diverse tracks showcased a band at the peak of their experimental powers.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a true showman. Remembering Freddie Mercury, whose incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound and influenced countless artists.
